problem:
Consider the matrix $X,$ given by

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}-3{R}_{1}$ on $X?$

examples.knowledge_point: Applying Row Operations To a Coefficients Matrix
examples.problem:
Consider the matrix $A,$ given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 2 & -1 \\ 7 & 12 & 13\end{aligned}]
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_2 := R_2 +(- 4) \cdot R_1$ on $A?$
examples.worked_solution:
The operation $R_2:=R_2 + (-4) R_1$ means that we need to add $-4$ times the first row to the second row. 

Carrying out this row operation, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 2 & -1 \\ 7 & 12 & 13\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-4)\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4+(-4)(1) & 2+(-4)(2) & -1+(-4)(3) \\ 7 & 12 & 13\end{aligned}] \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & -6 & -13 \\ 7 & 12 & 13\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
